Enable paired NFC tags first. For normal toggle/disable tags, use Write NFC tag instead.

Create QR codes that run Switchly actions when scanned. QR codes can enable, disable, toggle, or temporarily change Switchly.\n\nFor stricter setups, keep only QR enabled in Control modes and disable the other channels you do not want to use.

Saved barcodes turn printed or physical codes into Switchly actions. You can use them to enable, disable, toggle, or temporarily change Switchly without editing the app.\n\nFor stronger friction, place the barcode away from your phone and use Temporary Disable or Temporary Enable with “Ask when scanned”.

Paired tags let Switchly recognize an NFC tag by its UID. Read-only tags use the selected profile and action directly. Writable tags can keep the profile, action and duration stored on the tag or override them with a custom setup.\n\nDaily-use and cooldown limits apply to actual unlock or protection-pausing actions for both tag types.
